title: TalkTopicDef
description:
A talk topic definition from JSON type `"talk_topic"`.

Defines a node in an NPC dialogue tree with a dynamic line and a set of possible responses the player can choose from.

abstract_.description: Abstract flag — if true, this definition is a template.

copy_from.description: Base definition id to copy fields from.

dynamic.description: Whether this topic is a dynamic response calculated from the previous.

dynamic_line.description: The dialogue line spoken by the NPC. Can be a string, a structured object, or an array of alternatives.

id.description: Unique identifier (e.g. "TALK_HELLO", "TALK_DONE"). Can be a string or an array of strings (aliases).

repeat.description: Whether this topic can repeat (boolean or object).

replace_current.description: Whether to replace the current topic instead of pushing to the history stack.

TalkResponse.description: A response option within a talk topic.

always.description: Whether this response is always available.

condition.description: Optional condition that controls whether this response is available. Can be a string (e.g. "npc_available") or a condition object.

default.description: Whether this response is a default option.

effect.description: Effect(s) to apply when this response is chosen. Can be a single effect object or an array of effects.

failure_explanation.description: Explanation text shown when the response condition fails.

failure_topic.description: Topic to go to on condition failure (alternative to `failure.topic`).

falls_through.description: Whether this response falls through to the next matching response.

speech.description: Optional speech text for the NPC when this response is chosen.

switch.description: Whether this response switches the current topic.

text.description: Display text for this response option.

topic.description: The topic to transition to when this response is chosen. Can be a single topic string or an array of topic strings. May be absent for responses that only use `effect`.

trial.description: Optional trial that determines if the response succeeds.

TalkResult.description: Result of a trial success or failure.

TalkTrial.description: A trial that determines whether a response succeeds or fails.

condition.description: Condition for the trial (used with type "CONDITION").

skill_tier.description: Skill tier used for the trial.
